question: What alternative spatial ranges are allowed for the extent of the hall?
premises: A range from hall to hall-end is mentioned.
An alternative starting point from the enclosure wall is given.
The extent reaches up to the hall-end.
inference: The extent may run from hall to hall-end, or from the enclosure wall to the hall-end.
plain_english: It may extend from one hall to the end of a hall, or from the enclosure wall up to the end of the hall.
